title: Banana Republic Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Named after the owners' favorite Jimmy Buffet song, Banana Republic is a 3 BR, 2.5 bath stylish combination of tropical and mid-century décor that sleeps 6 and is located near the Westside community pool in Seaside, Florida.
description_expanded: Description842 Forest Street1 KING BED, 2 QUEEN BEDS, 1 TWIN- Sleeps 7Banana Republic | Classic Seaside Beach Cottage with Tower RoomInspired by the owner’s favorite Jimmy Buffett song, Banana Republic captures the carefree spirit of summer and delivers the ultimate Seaside, Florida beach cottage experience. Sleeping up to seven guests and ideally located near the heart of town, this charming home is perfect for families and friends looking to embrace laid-back coastal living and create memories they’ll want to revisit year after year.Inviting Front Porch on Forest StreetYour Seaside getaway begins on the expansive open-air front porch, furnished with Adirondack seating for four and overlooking the quiet, shaded stretch of Forest Street. This welcoming outdoor space is ideal for enjoying morning coffee, afternoon breezes, or evening cocktails beneath the trees.Step inside on the first floor to find two comfortable queen bedrooms, both conveniently located near the porch and sharing a full hallway bathroom—an ideal setup for guests seeking easy access and privacy.Open-Concept Living with Expansive Outdoor SpaceClimb the central staircase to the second floor, where an open-concept living area brings together the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. The kitchen is fully equipped with modern conveniences and features a breakfast bar with seating for four. Nearby, the dining table comfortably seats six, making it easy to gather for meals after a day at the beach.The living room offers ample seating and a large mounted flat-screen TV with cable, perfect for relaxed movie nights. French doors open to a second expansive open-air porch, featuring both lounge seating and an outdoor dining table for six. With peaceful treetop views, this porch effectively doubles the living space and enhances the home’s indoor-outdoor flow.Private Primary Suite & Additional BathThe split-level second floor also includes the king primary bedroom, a peaceful retreat complete with cable TV and spacious private bathroom featuring double vanities. A convenient half bath is located at the landing, adding extra comfort for guests and entertaining.Iconic Tower Room & Rooftop DeckThe third level is the true highlight of Banana Republic—a glass-enclosed tower room that opens onto an open-air deck. This elevated space includes a twin bed for an additional guest and offers beautiful views of the surrounding Seaside community. Whether you’re reading, relaxing, or simply taking in the scenery, this tower room is the perfect place to unwind and soak up the Seaside atmosphere.Your Laid-Back Seaside, Florida EscapeWith multiple porches, a tower room retreat, and a prime location, Banana Republic embodies everything guests love about a Seaside vacation rental. If you’re dreaming of a classic coastal getaway filled with sunshine, charm, and easygoing vibes, this Forest Street cottage invites you to experience Seaside at its best.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Summer. 3 Night Min for Fall. 2 Night Min for Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,218 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceLocated just 352 yards (approximately a 4-minute walk) to beach accessPrivate residential Seaside beach access at Natchez Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beach on Scenic Highway 30ARooftop deck offering elevated views and a relaxing outdoor retreatAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote featuring two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (golf carts are considered vehicles)Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002213
